opportunities.title: Main Grants (Research, Development and Analysis Fund)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to UK‑based organisations and individuals who have a formal employment or contractual relationship with the host institution for the project duration.
opportunities.summary: Supports research addressing priority questions from the Nuffield Foundation's Strategic Review, with grants up to £500,000 (special cases up to £750,000).

opportunities.title: Racial Diversity UK Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Encourages applications from diverse backgrounds, particularly racially minoritised communities, and partnership proposals; applicants must be based in the UK.
opportunities.summary: Supports research on racial diversity within the UK, focusing on inter‑generational changes, continuities and challenges, and their relation to the UK’s colonial past and changing demographics.
